title: Amazon Neptune Graph Assistant
description: A pattern demonstrating how to use Amazon Neptune with Strands agents for graph database operations, including memory knowledge graphs and graph queries using MCP servers

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Graph Assistant uses Amazon Neptune to store and query knowledge graphs for agent memory
A Memory Knowledge Graph MCP server manages graph structures and relationships
A Query System executes graph queries and handles analytics operations
Multiple MCP servers work together to handle different aspects of graph operations
AWS integration manages resources, controls access, and handles operations
